theme: An open day to clear the trip logistics.
greeting: A clear calendar today, Dan - no meetings until tomorrow's NACD New England call at noon. It's the kind of open stretch to knock out the overdue Croatia bookings before you fly on the 8th.

needsAttention.detail: Larissa Ravetto's chapter meeting is tomorrow at noon on Zoom. Worth arriving clear on what you want from NACDNE for the board search - and you haven't RSV'd the invite yet.

needsAttention.detail: Due today in Todoist so it's a test run before the Sept 3 House 1 to House 2 move. Get the pantry tote packed while there's still time to fix what doesn't work.

needsAttention.detail: p1, overdue since Aug 25. The issued ticket shows 0 checked bags; verify the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site and buy bags now if they aren't included.
